package.description: Use eSignature eID or eSignature card for e-Identity verification and signing of an electronic document on portals.

en-US.description: Use eSignature eID or eSignature card for e-Identity verification and signing of an electronic document on portals.
en-US.longDescription: In order to use the eSignature eID or eSignature card for e-Identity verification and signing of an electronic document on portals, you must enable eSignature extensions in your web browser settings, which is installed together with eParakstītājs 3.0.
